verdict.rationale: Twenty can be driven without its UI. It offers REST and GraphQL APIs with role-scoped API keys and batching, plus a Metadata API that changes the data model programmatically. It also has a CLI (create-twenty-app, app:publish, dev) for defining objects, fields and views as code, and a single-command scripted Docker install; a community user reports the REST API 'worked ok.' However, nothing documents CI use specifically, such as pipeline integration, non-interactive CLI authentication or headless deploy recipes. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation or examples, non-interactive CLI auth/token usage for pipelines, published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
